skill.displayName: Shopee-选品决策专家 | 青虎AI

llm.summary: This is a coherent Shopee market-analysis skill that discloses its paid Qinghu API use and token needs, though users should be aware it may export larger result sets to local files by default.

dimensions.detail: Network access to the Qinghu endpoint and use of a user-provided or environment Qinghu token are disclosed and proportionate to the data-reporting purpose.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is a single non-executable SKILL.md file with no installer, scripts, package hooks, or hidden setup behavior observed.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Trigger language is forceful, but the artifact also frames the skill as only for major full-report analysis, tells users to use a lighter related skill for routine product scouting, and requires consent before paid calls.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No background persistence, privilege escalation, or destructive behavior is present, but the skill instructs default table export for result arrays of 10 or more records and reuse of cached local data files.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill’s capabilities match its stated purpose: producing a full Shopee product-selection report using Qinghu market-data APIs for site, category, shop, item, price, and search-term analysis.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this if you expect the agent to run paid Qinghu Shopee market-analysis workflows. Before use, confirm which Qinghu tools will be called, what token is being used, expected point costs, and where exported spreadsheets or cached data files will be stored.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: The mandatory trigger phrasing is somewhat broad, but it is bounded to full Shopee product-selection reports and high-investment decisions, and the skill requires authorization before paid tool use.
[SQP-1] expected: The trigger examples do not include a dedicated non-trigger list, but the artifact does include practical boundaries by saying routine product scouting should use a related lighter skill.
[SQP-2] expected: Exporting large result sets is aligned with the reporting workflow and is disclosed, but users should understand that files can be created locally without a separate per-export confirmation.
